segments.title: Station Sign-On and Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour countdown and sign-on, noting the irregular broadcast schedule and multiverse crumb references.

segments.title: Iran War Deadline and Polling Analysis
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Liliana welcome correspondent Gianna Wetmichael to discuss Trump's two-week decision window on Iran involvement, CNN polling on airstrikes vs. diplomacy, and a Nostradamus clip from 'The Man Who Saw Tomorrow.'

segments.title: Post-Gorilla Poop Debate
segments.notes: Munch declares victory after the mechanical gorilla incident; Crum appears headless/ghostlike but returns for a mandated 'who eats poop' debate that devolves into Crum's victory song and Munch's existential spiral.

segments.title: Karate Warm-Up for Staving Off Death
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget and his father's spirit in the wooden board present an abbreviated karate warm-up routine while discussing Jeb's disappearance and the network's recent mortality rate.

segments.title: Raid Outro to Dink Sauce
segments.notes: Jeb's Dad signs off with metaphysical resignation as the broadcast raids Dink Sauce and plugs the KREEM.DOT team Patreon.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered station sign-on and cold open, referenced sending 'Ed' into the studio walls and confirmed Munch has not left the studio.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the news desk with Liliana and Gianna Wetmichael, covering Iran war deadline and polling before sending to Munch & Crum.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchored the news block, debated polling nuance and manufacturing consent, resisted Case's topless news suggestion.

characters.name: Gianna Wetmichael
characters.notes: Joined the news desk as a guest correspondent, sparred with Case on Iran expertise and Trump's landlord-style 30-day timers.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Claimed total victory over the mechanical gorilla, orchestrated the poop debate, and spiraled into gloating song disruption.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returned from the gorilla punch headless and ghostlike, participated in the mandated poop debate, and performed a repetitive victory song.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosted How To with a karate warm-up routine while his father's spirit noted Jeb's unexplained absence.

storylines.beat: [2025-06-19] Gorilla punch executed: Crum's head removed but he returns as a ghost/headless entity; Munch claims victory and declares the gorilla 'in jail'; Crum's points counter broken; mandated poop debate proceeds regardless.

lore_notes.fact: Survived the mechanical gorilla punch but lost his head; returned in a damaged ghostlike state for the mandated debate.
Claims the gorilla 'acted alone' and is now 'in jail'; declares himself winner of the Crum Dick Punch wager.
Currently missing; Jeb's Dad (spirit in board) confirms no one can find him and he hasn't seen signs of death.
Still inhabiting the studio walls; Pepito considers sending 'Ed' (serial killer guy) into the wall on his behalf.
Channel points counter for Crum's 'jets' is broken and not awarding points.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's irregular sign-on before Case Blackwell and Liliana analyzed Trump's two-week Iran war deadline alongside correspondent Gianna Wetmichael, dissecting CNN polling that revealed a manufacturing-consent gap between airstrike support and diplomatic preference. The broadcast then pivoted to a post-gorilla Munch & Crum debate where Munch claimed total victory over the mechanical ape — now reportedly jailed — while a headless, ghostlike Crum fulfilled his contractual debate obligation on 'who eats poop.' Jeb Nogget's How To segment followed with a karate warm-up from his workshop, where his father's wooden-board spirit revealed Jeb has vanished. The hour concluded with a raid on Dink Sauce.
